LocalizedProperties.ProductDescription:
Welcome to Call of Duty®: Warzone™, the massive free-to-play combat arena. Experience thrilling modes & new gameplay features in Verdansk and Rebirth Island.

Haven's Hollow Debuts in Call of Duty®: Warzone™.

Something strange is afoot in Haven’s Hollow. The all-new Resurgence Map makes its debut in Season 01, dropping players into an isolated Appalachian town that feels like a living relic of old school American charm. Though the picturesque town may be shrouded in mystery, it’s also the stage for fast-paced, frenetic action.

Players can also drop into Verdansk and fight through new and reimagined POIs. And before long, it’ll be time to bundle up for winter with the return of CODMAS. Drop in, lock on, and eliminate anything in your way.

Loot For Rewards
Discover supply boxes and complete contracts to build your arsenal and gain a tactical advantage.


A mobile phone number linked to your Activision account may be required to play Call of Duty®: Warzone™.

A Game Pass Core subscription is not required to play Call of Duty®: Warzone™. All other online modes still require Game Pass Core.

For more information, please visit www.callofduty.com.
